parsed.rationale: All three members — `PlaybackBlendMode`, `MaterialBlendMode`, and `OverlayBlendMode` — are `type-alias-union` declarations in the same package (`Wallpaper`) with identical structure (`shared_field_count: 16`, `differing_slots: null`), meaning they are exact duplicates sharing all 16 union cases. None carry test, codegen, mock, or sample-app flags, so the duplication is unintentional. The idiomatic Swift fix is to define a single canonical `BlendMode` type-alias-union in the `Wallpaper` package (e.g., in a new `BlendMode.swift` under `Shared/Wallpaper/Sources/Wallpaper/Core/`) and replace the three site-specific aliases with `typealias PlaybackBlendMode = BlendMode`, `typealias MaterialBlendMode = BlendMode`, and `typealias OverlayBlendMode = BlendMode` — or remove the aliases entirely if call sites can be migrated to `BlendMode` directly. This eliminates the risk of the three definitions drifting apart as new blend-mode cases are added.
